issue.title: Document every contextual duplicate app-key pair
issue.description: PROPOSED BY phase bead sase-u6.2 note 1. docs/configuration.md says its shared-key table lists exactly the allowed contextual app-action pairs, but the runtime allowlist also contains agents_revive/beads_launch_work and agents_revive/reword. The table therefore documents 8 of 10 current pairs and misstates the accepted configuration surface. Add both missing rows and keep the table aligned with _CONTEXTUAL_APP_DUPLICATES.

task_type_fields.impact: Users and maintainers cannot discover two intentionally supported duplicate app bindings, and the documentation claim that the table is exact is false.
task_type_fields.repro: Compare the shared-key table at docs/configuration.md:1200-1209 with _CONTEXTUAL_APP_DUPLICATES at src/sase/ace/tui/keymaps/registry.py:92-107; two agents_revive pairs are absent.
